note: A mixin getter's body changes. AOT copies it into dart:mixin_deduplication's &Base&Labelled and calls reach that copy, which a patch cannot replace, so the patch is refused and names the copied member. The frozen reference tooling calls this inert, so it is not a witness here.
rejectionReasons: this member of a mixin changed; AOT copies a mixin's members into each class that applies it, and a patch cannot replace those copies
